stem.text: The diagram shows a man standing on a platform that is attached to a flexible pipe. Water is pumped through the pipe so that the man and platform remain at a constant height.

stem.alt: Man standing on a platform attached to a horizontal flexible pipe labelled water in, with the pipe labelled flexible pipe, and a vertical downward arrow labelled vertical jet of water out, mass flow rate 40 kg s-1.

stem.text: The resultant vertical force on the platform is zero. The combined mass of the man and platform is $96\,\text{kg}$. The mass of water that is discharged vertically downwards from the platform each second is $40\,\text{kg}$.
What is the speed of the water leaving the platform?
